about: Scripted replies for the e2e model stub. First rule whose markers ALL appear in the prompt wins (case-insensitive; a marker starting with re: is a regex). channel is chat (OpenAI), cli (fake claude) or any. A rule's files are written by the CLI lane directly and by the native lane as write_file tool calls. Order matters: put the narrow rules first. Every reply is chosen so it does not contain another rule's markers, because a later stage's prompt quotes an earlier stage's reply.
